(((sum by (cluster, change_id) (max by (cluster, change_id, change_type, operation_type, status) (taskite_pd_broker_change_operations{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster",status="completed"}))) or on (cluster, change_id) (0 * sum by (cluster, change_id) (max by (cluster, change_id, change_type, operation_type, status) (taskite_pd_broker_change_operations{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster"})))) / sum by (cluster, change_id) (max by (cluster, change_id, change_type, operation_type, status) (taskite_pd_broker_change_operations{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster"}))) and on (cluster, change_id) ((max by (cluster, change_id) (taskite_pd_broker_change_started_at_seconds{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster"}) >= $__from / 1000) and (max by (cluster, change_id) (taskite_pd_broker_change_started_at_seconds{pd_node=~"$pd_node",cluster=~"$cluster"}) <= $__to / 1000))
